why_seated: The syllogism taken into the concept: Der Schluß des Daseyns, der Reflexion, der Nothwendigkeit. It extends Hegel's seat, which held the Differenz and the Plato lectures only.
verified_loci: the syllogism chapter — 'A. Der Schluß des Daseyns.' (text/wissenschaft-der-logik-2.txt)
the syllogism as the posited concept — 'Der Schluß ist somit der vollständig gesetzte Begriff' (text/wissenschaft-der-logik-2.txt)
Der Schluß der Nothwendigkeit — 'C. Der Schluß der Nothwendigkeit.' (text/wissenschaft-der-logik-2.txt)

research.study: Critique of Pure Inference (working draft v1.1) and The Production of Readers (#1767), §11.6 "the witnesses between"
research.for: the reception history of inference from the Peripatos to the machine: the commentators who name Aristotle's ἑταῖροι, the Latin handbooks, the early-modern refusals of the syllogism, the nineteenth-century rebuilds, and the traditions that reasoned about inference without the Organon
